prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop hospitality homepage concept, 1440px-wide landscape canvas, rendered edge to edge without a browser or device frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact resort logo; Image 2 is the real resort exterior aerial; Image 3 is the real living-room interior; Image 4 is a real apartment bedroom. Use the supplied property photographs as recognizable fixed footage frames. Preserve the actual buildings and interiors; do not invent a new resort.
Primary request: Direction C — Cinematic Hospitality for ‘The 12 by Naji Resort’. Create a real, usable homepage first viewport with the rhythm of an elegant film opening. Make a single full-bleed exterior frame the dominant image, softly graded but still faithful, held inside narrow matte-black letterbox bands. Place the refined line ‘Where Resort Amenities Meet Residential Elegance.’ at large scale in the lower third, with ‘Redefining Resort Living’ as a small title-card line. Use one quiet frame counter such as ‘UTAKO · ABUJA’, never fake coordinates or ratings.
Frame: a transparent minimal header with the exact resort mark/name, Rooms, Gallery, Tours, Events, Contact, and a clear gold ‘Book Now’ control. The working stay planner is a dark cinematic rail across the lower edge with ‘Check in’, ‘Check out’, ‘Apartment’, and ‘View apartments’. Below the first frame, show the beginning of a black editorial sequence titled ‘An apartment resort’, with one large living-room still and one smaller bedroom still, like restrained film frames rather than cards.
Visual law: absolute black #090909, soft bone #ECE7DC, muted brass #C79A45, smoke #272727. Elegant cinematic serif titles and a precise sans for controls. Sharp geometry, no glass, no gradients, no glow, no decorative film sprockets, no carousels.
Constraints: accessible readable text, one dominant image, purposeful booking action, no prices, reviews, awards, fake availability, people, stock imagery, extra logos, or invented hotel facts.
